title: Fix Paste Target Size And Story Layout
description: Fix paste target design to be 9 pieces / 8 connections (flat tambour + capsules). Fix story layout: target below source, two diff outputs (WithCoord + WithoutCoord) in one story.
summary: Fixed windows not showing in CopyAndPaste story. Root cause: custom LAYOUT used `id` and `label` on window nodes but UIWindowLayoutWindowNode requires `windowKindId` and `title`. convertWindowLayoutNodeToGoldenConfig reads `child.windowKindId` for GoldenLayout componentName — with `id` it was undefined, so no windows rendered. Also fixed TypeScript error on metabolismKit.designs cast.
